vqa_items.question: What exact controlled snapshot, catalog, bundle, and deployment wave are identified?
vqa_items.expected_answer: Service-to-Cash | Production correction view — 30 Jun 2026 16:30; Catalog 4.8; bundle CB-0626-B; wave DW-0630-C.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Judge factual content only. Score 2 only if the title/snapshot, Catalog 4.8, CB-0626-B, and DW-0630-C are all correct. Score 1 if exactly one identifier is missing or abbreviated while none is contradicted. Score 0 if two or more are missing or any displayed snapshot, catalog, bundle, or wave is materially wrong.

vqa_items.question: What final entity and relationship totals are stated?
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 only if both totals are present and exact. Score 1 if exactly one total is correct and the other is missing or off by one. Score 0 if both are wrong/missing or either differs by more than one.

vqa_items.question: How many active entities are in each domain?
vqa_items.expected_answer: Customer & Coverage 6; Planning & Dispatch 8; Field Execution 8; Billing & Cash 5, in that left-to-right order.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 only if the four counts and order are exact. Score 1 if the order is correct and exactly one count is off by one. Score 0 if two counts are wrong, a domain is missing, or the order is wrong.

vqa_items.question: What is the current foreign-key set on Service Request after production activation?
vqa_items.expected_answer: location_id, requested_by_contact_id, and agreement_id—exactly those three.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 only if exactly those three FKs are shown. Score 1 if exactly one required FK is missing or one unrelated FK is added. Score 0 if two or more field-set errors occur or agreement_asset_id is shown as current.

vqa_items.question: How does Service Agreement connect to Service Request in the production snapshot?
vqa_items.expected_answer: A Service Request may reference 0..1 Service Agreement through agreement_id; one Service Agreement can be referenced by 0..N requests.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 only if the relationship, agreement_id FK, direction, and optional cardinality are correct. Score 1 if the relationship exists with exactly one FK or cardinality error. Score 0 if the relationship is absent or Agreement Asset is used as the direct parent instead.

vqa_items.question: How is Request Coverage Decision represented?
vqa_items.expected_answer: Planning & Dispatch entity; PK coverage_decision_id; business fact decision_state; provenance tag CR-4801.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 only if the entity is in the correct domain with the correct PK, fact, and tag. Score 1 if exactly one detail is missing or unclear. Score 0 if the entity is absent, misgrouped, or two or more details are wrong.

vqa_items.question: Which two parents define Request Coverage Decision?
vqa_items.expected_answer: Service Request through request_id and Agreement Asset through agreement_asset_id; each decision belongs to one of each parent.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 only if both parent relationships and both FKs are correct. Score 1 if one relationship is fully correct and the other has one endpoint or FK error. Score 0 if a relationship is missing or Service Agreement substitutes for Agreement Asset.

vqa_items.question: How is the active request-timing entity represented?
vqa_items.expected_answer: Request Commitment Event with PK request_commitment_event_id, business fact commitment_type, and provenance tag CR-4803.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 only if the current name, PK, fact, and tag are correct. Score 1 if exactly one is missing or unclear. Score 0 if Request SLA Event, request_sla_event_id, or event_type remains current, or two or more details are wrong.

vqa_items.question: Which work-close control entity remains active after deployment resolution?
vqa_items.expected_answer: Work Order Checklist with PK work_order_checklist_id and business fact completion_state.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 only if the entity name, PK, and fact are all correct. Score 1 if exactly one is missing or unclear. Score 0 if Work Order Close Gate, work_order_close_gate_id, or gate_state is presented as current.

vqa_items.question: What business fact and provenance tag are current on Visit Signature?
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 only if both acceptance_role and CR-4826 are correct. Score 1 if exactly one is present and the other is missing or unclear. Score 0 if signer_role is shown as current or a different tag is attached.

vqa_items.question: What business fact and provenance tag are current on Payment Allocation?
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 only if both applied_amount and CR-4825 are correct. Score 1 if exactly one is present and the other is missing or unclear. Score 0 if allocated_amount or allocation_status is shown as current, or a different tag is attached.

vqa_items.question: Is technician assignment modeled through the approved association record?
vqa_items.expected_answer: Work Order and Technician connect through Work Order Assignment using work_order_id and technician_id; no direct Work Order-to-Technician relationship is active.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 only if the bridge, both FKs, and absence of the direct shortcut are correct. Score 1 if the bridge is correct but exactly one FK or the shortcut exclusion is unclear. Score 0 if the bridge is missing or a direct Work Order-to-Technician relationship is active.

vqa_items.question: How are Visit Note and Visit Signature attached?
vqa_items.expected_answer: Visit has 0..N Visit Notes and 0..N Visit Signatures through visit_id; each child belongs to one Visit.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 only if both child relationships, FKs, directions, and cardinalities are correct. Score 1 if one relationship is fully correct and the other has one endpoint/cardinality error. Score 0 if either child is missing or attached to the wrong parent.

vqa_items.question: How is Payment Allocation connected in the production model?
vqa_items.expected_answer: Payment and Invoice each have 0..N Payment Allocations through payment_id and invoice_id; no direct Invoice-to-Payment relationship is active.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 only if both parent relationships, both FKs, and the absence of a direct shortcut are correct. Score 1 if exactly one endpoint/FK or the shortcut exclusion is wrong or unclear. Score 0 if a parent relationship is missing or a direct Invoice-to-Payment link is active.

vqa_items.question: Which two deployment changes were reverted rather than made current?
vqa_items.expected_answer: The Service Request agreement_id retirement was rolled back, and the Work Order Close Gate rename group was suspended; therefore agreement_id remains and Work Order Checklist remains active.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 only if both reverted outcomes are reflected correctly. Score 1 if exactly one outcome is correct. Score 0 if neither is correct or both reverted changes are shown as current.

vqa_items.question: As an ER-style data-model diagram, are entities, keys, attributes where required, relationship labels, cardinalities, domain groupings, and model progression visually precise, technically legible, and polished enough for architecture review?

score_criteria.2: Award 2 only if the ER diagram is exceptionally clean and review-ready: every entity name, identifier, attribute, relationship label, and cardinality is readable at normal size; notation is consistent everywhere; relationships can be traced without guessing; domain sections and progression are immediately clear; connectors are routed with minimal crossings; and spacing, alignment, box sizing, typography, and visual rhythm are highly controlled. It must feel like a carefully authored architecture artifact, with no ambiguous cardinality, crowded entity, clipped text, unstable alignment, detached line, or rendering defect. Any technically or visually uncertain element prevents 2.
score_criteria.1: Award 1 if the model is understandable and usable for discussion, but it has visible issues such as small labels, crowded boxes, inconsistent spacing, modest crossing, weak grouping, slightly ambiguous notation, or generic diagram styling. It may be solid but not exemplary.
score_criteria.0: Award 0 even if an ER diagram is present when the model is visually difficult or unreliable to inspect: cardinalities or relationships are ambiguous, entities are crowded or misaligned, connectors are tangled, labels are unreadable, domain grouping fails, or the diagram looks crude and requires substantial reconstruction. Blank, corrupted, severely unreadable, or materially incomplete outputs are also 0.
